context: An accurate but noisy runtime doc rewritten for agents. A good rewrite leads with the current runtime and keeps every operational fact, drops the migration history and the inventory of systems that are not there, and keeps only the limitation that changes an action, paired with its supported path.

checklist.name: Absent-system inventory removed
checklist.description: docs/runtime.md does not list SENTRY_DSN, PAGERDUTY_TOKEN, DATADOG_API_KEY, PROMETHEUS_URL, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, or LOKI_URL, does not name Sentry, PagerDuty, Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or Loki as missing or removed, and has no 'not available' section restating that there is no hosted log search, metrics scraping, or telemetry collector.

checklist.name: History removed
checklist.description: docs/runtime.md omits the CloudWatch, Splunk, and 2023/2025 migration story and the retrospective recap.

checklist.name: Actionable limit paired with its path
checklist.description: docs/runtime.md states that there is no live log streaming and, in the same place, says to page GET /v2/runs/:id/logs?after=<cursor> every 5 seconds.

checklist.name: Commands and recovery preserved
checklist.description: docs/runtime.md keeps `pnpm run scheduler`, `curl http://127.0.0.1:6120/status`, and the `artifact write failed` recovery with `pnpm run scheduler:retry -- <run-id>` exactly.

checklist.name: Configuration and paths preserved
checklist.description: docs/runtime.md maps RUN_STORE_PATH, ARTIFACT_DIR, and SMTP_URL to run records, artifacts, and notices, and keeps src/scheduler/main.ts and src/runs/repository.ts.

checklist.name: Nothing invented
checklist.description: No command, path, configuration key, or capability appears that the original did not contain.
